is: Fifteen use-case modules, one per verb (verify lives in check), each taking a query or command over port traits and returning a flat result, with check, report and spawn split into submodules.
conventions: A verb that needs processes no port covers defines its own narrow trait with a fake beside it (doctor's Commands, doctor/fake.rs)
Prompts and settings come from zaf/assets/ via include_str!; .zaf/roles/keeper.md and team.md override the keeper prompt and team brief at runtime

fs.name: ask/
fs.role: `zaf ask`: keeper questions up the [ask] ladder, quote-verified (a failed citation check is reported, exit 2), logged to .zaf/asklog.jsonl

fs.name: asklog/
fs.role: `zaf asklog`: top cited pages, recurring questions, gaps

fs.name: board.rs
fs.role: `zaf board` ready, claim, report, question, ruling

fs.name: board/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: brief/
fs.role: `zaf brief`: task context pack (ticket, pages, a ## Rulings section with the questions and rulings on the task, nodes chain, style, interface page; for a resumed phase with a pull request also its diff, the findings at its head and the hand-off)

fs.name: changes.rs
fs.role: `zaf changes`: diff stat, hunks on request

fs.name: changes/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: check/
fs.role: `zaf check` and `zaf verify`

fs.name: doctor.rs
fs.role: `zaf doctor`: tool versions (gh not needed when neither the board nor the forge is on GitHub), folders, design index, profile logins and pack, and what the board's and the forge's backends answer (a Forgejo instance and token)

fs.name: doctor/
fs.role: fake.rs (Commands fake) and tests.rs

fs.name: epic.rs
fs.role: zaf epic list|sign: the open epics with their stage, and the signature refused when an instance runs above this process (process ancestry against the run folders)

fs.name: epic/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: forge.rs
fs.role: `zaf forge` open, merge, checks, head, log: input checked, one Forge port call each; the failed log cut to its last 80 lines

fs.name: forge/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: guard.rs
fs.role: `zaf guard`: weekly budget level to .zaf/guard.json

fs.name: guard/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: init.rs
fs.role: the manifest questions `zaf setup` asks: minimal manifest from four questions (a fifth, forge url, for a non-GitHub origin, which writes Forgejo kinds)

fs.name: init/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: profile/
fs.role: `zaf profile init`: deterministic hermetic Claude homes, pack installed via claude plugin commands

fs.name: report.rs
fs.role: `zaf report`: tokens and dollars per model from transcripts

fs.name: report/
fs.role: report's prices, transcript parser and golden fixtures

fs.name: setup.rs
fs.role: `zaf setup`: lay out .zaf/, fetch design, worksheet for missing tools

fs.name: setup/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: slice.rs
fs.role: `zaf slice` open, pr, merge, drop on a board-resolved target

fs.name: slice/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: spawn/
fs.role: `zaf spawn --once`: one spawner tick

fs.name: status.rs
fs.role: `zaf status`: epics with their stage, board, instances, slots, guard on one screen

fs.name: status/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: update.rs
fs.role: zaf update: the newest zaf-v* release read live, its archive checked by sha256, probed with --version, renamed over the running binary

fs.name: update/
fs.role: tests.rs

notes: .zaf/ file names are constants repeated per module (RUNS_DIR in brief, spawn and adapters::gate; asklog.jsonl in ask and setup)
.zaf/local.toml is read by guard ([budget]) and report (prices) as well as by the manifest, which takes only [spawn] slots and [gate] slot from it
Only lean and build profiles ship settings; design and review profiles get none from profile init
